question: On the first automatically observed immutable snapshot whose chronological first-960 prefix contains at least 522 physical runs, does the disjoint increment beyond snapshot 887 retain broad within-task and within-run tree-linearization distortion under the already disclosed thresholds?
scientific_role: Forward-accrual confirmation on a disjoint physical-run increment; not a rescue or rerun of the failed snapshot-887 formal classification.

freeze_state.baseline_failure_reason: The exact task-marginal fraction 45605749/284435765 formatted as 0.16033760381715709, while an upstream JSON-float display had been pre-recorded as 0.1603376038171571; the strict textual round-trip gate failed.

activation_rule.target_derivation: ceil(435 * 6/5) = 522; the increment is exactly 20 percent of the frozen baseline run count.
activation_rule.candidate: the first immutable LATEST observed by the public five-second monitor after its source commit whose provisional_first960_runs is at least 522

primary_population.name: disjoint_forward_physical_run_increment
primary_population.membership: all endpoints belonging to candidate provisional-first960 physical runs whose run_id is absent from the exact baseline snapshot

tree_estimand.observed_edge: child to parent only when both endpoints occur inside the disjoint increment
tree_estimand.canonical_edge_measure: one unit per observed child-parent edge
tree_estimand.path_frequency_measure: an edge receives multiplicity equal to its number of descendant observed-fragment leaves
tree_estimand.primary_by_axis: W_p(G)=sum_g(E_g/E) TV(uniform edges within g, path-frequency edges within g)
tree_estimand.secondary_by_axis: W_q(G)=sum_g(M_g/M) TV(uniform edges within g, path-frequency edges within g)

classification_rule: Hard-gate failure takes precedence. Otherwise an axis is strong only when its exact W_p, breadth, and anti-dominance gates all pass. Both axes strong yields BROAD; exactly one yields the matching one-axis class; any positive W_p below strong gates yields PROFILE_BELOW; exact zero on both axes yields NO_OBSERVED. Neither decimal formatting, W_q, the cumulative snapshot, nor the snapshot-887 profile may rescue a primary gate.

claim_boundary.allowed_if_broad: In the first automatically selected Target-522 snapshot, the disjoint forward increment of at least 87 physical runs independently retains broad within-task and within-run edge-measure distortion under thresholds fixed after snapshot 887 but before any candidate identity or increment profile was observed.

failure_rule: Any selection, continuity, snapshot, append-only, hash, schema, graph, support, exact-rational, security, reproducibility, or independent-verification mismatch fails closed. No same-snapshot threshold, population, formatting, or interpretation repair is allowed.
